title: Evolutionary Games
description: Let the winners have more offspring and the game plays itself: the mix a population settles into is the one nothing can invade. Unlocks the Evolutionarily Stable Strategy.

puzzle.goal: Fighters win a prize V; when two aggressive ones meet, both risk an injury costing C. When a share P of the population is aggressive, write how much more G an aggressive fighter earns than a timid one.
puzzle.name: Stable mix
puzzle.ask: Find G for V = @{V}, P = @{P} and C = @{C}.
puzzle.method: Aggressive: P(V − C)/2 + (1 − P)V. Timid: (1 − P)V/2. Their difference is (V − PC)/2, zero at P = V/C: there the population stops changing.
